blocks.x: Achala IT Solutions EEMS Platform reaches general availability for decision intelligence, the announcement, what changes for clients, and where to go next.

On 2026-10-28 Achala IT Solutions EEMS Platform reaches general availability for decision intelligence. The work behind it ran through the same delivery discipline we sell: a signed scope, named owners, and evidence reviewed at gates before anything was announced.

The reason EEMS Platform reaches general availability for decision intelligence earns a program rather than a pilot: it sits on a decision path with budget attached, where measured deltas become money rather than slides.
